terms.canonical_id: Stable lowercase dash-separated identifier for engines, schemas, and artifacts.
terms.run_seed: SHA256(commit_sha + recon_id + execution_nonce) - deterministic seed for executions.
terms.recon_id: Canonical reconstruction identifier for provenance runs.
terms.config_version: Immutable configuration artifact (hash + semantic version) used across an execution.
terms.Approval Evidence: Signed artifact proving human approval. Required to mark candidate artifacts authoritative.
terms.execution_manifest: Canonical representation of the planned execution; includes execution_graph and schedule.
terms.execution_graph: Directed acyclic graph (DAG) of engine invocation nodes embedded in execution_manifest.
terms.evidence_graph: Content-addressed graph of evidence nodes produced by Evidence Aggregation Engine.
terms.decision_record: Signed artifact describing a deterministic decision with cause, action, and evidence references.
terms.context_snapshot: Immutable snapshot of execution inputs and overlays provided to engines.
terms.audit_bundle: Content-addressed packaged audit archive produced by Audit Engine.
terms.policy_registry: Canonical set of policy rules enforced by Policy Enforcement Engine.
terms.capability_registry: Canonical list of capability identifiers and metadata used by the Execution Planner.
terms.engine_registry: Canonical list of engine runtime contracts and metadata.
terms.determinism_proof: Proof that a run is deterministic: replay checksums and results.
terms.evidence_produced: Artifacts produced by an engine during execution, recorded in evidence_graph.
terms.tie-breaker: Lexicographic ordering on canonical_id used to deterministically break score ties.
terms.immutable: An artifact or snapshot that must not be changed after creation; any change requires new artifact with provenance.
terms.seeded: Lifecycle status indicating an artifact is a seeded (candidate) entry pending Approval Evidence.
terms.signed_approval: A signed decision_record type artifact produced by Human Interaction Engine to record approvals.
terms.provenance: Metadata containing { run_seed, recon_id, commit_sha, config_version } used to trace artifact origin.
terms.evidence_manifest: Catalog of evidence templates, directories, and validation rules for EOS v1.0.
